case.title: Midnight at Maple Manor
case.introduction: A storm hits Maple Manor. A priceless painting is gone. One guest is a fake. Find who.
case.escape_plan: The thief will run at dawn.

characters.name: Eve Blackwood
characters.secret: She is not Eve, her real name is Sarah.
lies: I saw no one leave the house.

characters.name: Tom Rivers
characters.secret: He once hid a food stash.

characters.name: Lila Hart
characters.secret: She knows where the painting is hidden.

characters.name: Nina Park
characters.alibi: In the dining room at 8:50 PM.

evidence.name: Broken Frame
evidence.description: The frame is broken on the floor.

evidence.name: Paint Brush
evidence.description: A brush with paint on it.

hidden_clues: Eve says she saw no one leave the house. That is false.
Eve keeps a watch on the clock. She is not on time.
red_herrings: Tom says he saw no one in the attic. He is lying about the time.

solution.reasoning: The frame is broken in the attic. The brush has paint. Eve was in the attic. Her name is fake.

state.current_objective: One of the 6 guests at Maple Manor is using a fake name. Look for clues, compare their stories, and unmask the one behind the painting was stolen. There are many clues to help you.

exchanges.question: tell me about your self
exchanges.answer: Hi. I’m Eve Blackwood, 28. I work as an art curator. I love quiet places and always check the clock.

exchanges.question: hello eve
exchanges.answer: Hi. I’m still here. What do you need?

exchanges.question: Look around
exchanges.answer: The room is quiet. The lights are dim. The painting is on the wall. The clock ticks softly.

exchanges.question: you see any unusual on your room
exchanges.answer: No. The room is quiet. The clock ticks. The painting looks the same.

exchanges.question: which time all you gether
exchanges.answer: The clock says 10:40. I check it now.

exchanges.question: you know every person on this manor
exchanges.answer: I don’t know. I only know the people who work here. I check the clock again.

exchanges.question: who work here regular
exchanges.answer: I work here as the art curator. The house has a few staff – the butler, the gardener, and a cleaning lady. Those are the people who come in every day.

exchanges.question: you don't know about security guard
exchanges.answer: I don’t know anything about a security guard. I only see the staff who work daily. The clock says 11:10.
